rv.q: TANGO is the delightful product of a talented playwright, superb actors, and a splendid crew.
Joel Tan's script is full of jaw-dropping twists, and the superb direction by Carol Ann Tan keeps the action moving at a brisk pace.
"Tango" is timely, poignant, sometimes very funny and totally heart-wrenching that gives wings to the Butterfly Effect.
I think the story is worth telling and the acting was well done.
